review_scope: Pre-freeze Gong and other-mechanism experimental labels, source denominators, direction semantics and coverage of eight prior literature metadata rows. No V1 or RC scores, ranks, candidates or model comparisons inspected.

independence.prior_literature_access: Only source_id, tested_rsids, target_gene and literature_caveat columns were extracted from the frozen R009 literature register. No model values were exposed.

checks.evidence: Original supplementary DOCX Methods paragraph 37 explicitly requires significance from all three methods with Benjamini-Hochberg-adjusted P<0.05. This is a conjunction, not an any-method rule. It applies to QuASAR, mpralm_sum and DESeq2 fields in S2.

Independently read the original XLS with xlrd, recognizing its two header rows, and compared every QuASAR/mpralm_sum/DESeq2 field to the extracted TSVs. All three sheets contain 2,306 body rows. No differences above 1e-14; maximum serialization difference was 6.462348535570529e-27. Original NA fields remain absent, not zeros.

Independently applied the published conjunction to all 6,714 reported experimental result rows and compared with curation. Zero state mismatches. Six additional design-defined rows absent from S2 remain unavailable, yielding 6,720 expected experimental cell/orientation contrasts.

Two rs76419734 orientation rows are absent in each cell. Twelve HUVEC and two MRC5 reported contrasts lack a required method statistic. None is labeled null or positive. The 6,671 nulls are complete reported contrasts that fail the authors' consensus rule, not inferred absence-of-hit labels. Nonsignificance is assay-specific, not biological inactivity.

The source DOCX stores the two missing comparison glyphs as Symbol F0A3 (less-than-or-equal). Barcode thresholds are mean DNA count <=10 in 16HBE/MRC5 and <=3 in HUVEC; low-correlation DNA replicates are removed. A per-variant QC/exclusion ledger and the reason for missing rs76419734 are absent. Complete-assayed-denominator validity is correctly false despite extensive recoverable null results. No full-panel sensitivity, specificity, AUROC/AP or false-positive-rate claim is supported.

Design CON controls are in the context/exclusion collection, not the 1,120-variant experimental denominator. S2 provides statistical evidence but no signed allele effect; curation correctly withholds direction. GWAS effect alleles in S3 and QBiC TF predictions are not treated as measured reporter direction or experimental TF-binding labels.

Independently visually inspected primary Figure 3B and read its caption, Results and statistical methods. Isolated rs6537296 G-to-A on rs1542725=T background is significant in the forward insert and explicitly NS in reverse. Isolated rs1542725 T-to-C on rs6537296=G background is explicitly NS in forward and significant in reverse. Thus four exact contrast rows contain two positive and two null outcomes. The double-mutant risk haplotype is kept separately and is not substituted for either single nucleotide.

Primary Figure 4 and Results support greater Sp3 binding with rs1542725-C. This remains TF_binding with partial model scope, not a higher-reporter-activity label. Contacts and the two-SNP haplotype are contextual. Experimental insert orientation is not equated with computational frozen-sequence reverse complementation.

Independently viewed primary Figure 1. Its pairs are rs2276936 forward A/C, reverse T/G; rs2167750 forward C/T, reverse G/A; rs7695177 forward C/G, reverse G/C. The single marked allelic significance is rs2276936 forward, with A higher than C. Five unmarked contrasts have no explicit NS or numerical P and remain ambiguous, not inferred null. Reverse labels are preserved as printed; central genomic complementation remains a separate harmonization step. rs7695177 is palindromic.

HepG2 reporter experiments are a metabolic follow-up of the COPD FAM13A locus, not an independent COPD disease-validation panel. Reused Castaldi MPRA positives are identified as the same original experiment in contextual evidence and source-reported summaries, not counted as new independent replication. Regional deletion does not establish exact allele editing.

Primary Methods and Results confirm long-read RNA from five AA and five GG LTRC lung donors, with exon/isoform usage differences and an allele-dependent splice acceptor. This is not an isogenic edit. The splicing label has mechanism_in_model_scope=no. Four explicit nonsignificant isoform endpoints are preserved as within-assay contexts, not independent variants. Structural consequences are predictions, not direct protein-function experiments. NPNT cannot be counted as an enhancer/H3K27me3 false negative.

Direct primary text confirms rs7962469-A higher than G in both 16HBE and Jurkat (Boueiz Figure 5 has allelic P=.008); Hao reports rs2076295-T higher DSP promoter activity and TT higher DSP expression than GG in HDR clones. Regional deletion/CRISPRi are separately contextual. Hao's IPF-risk direction must not be assumed to be COPD-risk direction.

The mechanism collection contains deliberately selected variants, correlated HHIP contrasts, different assays/cells and an out-of-scope splice mechanism. Its complete_positive_null_panel and performance_metrics_permitted fields are false. Four enumerated HHIP tests do not turn two selected linked SNPs into an independent screening panel. Counts and descriptive case recovery are appropriate; population-like performance metrics are not.
Metadata-only audit maps all eight frozen V1 literature observations to exact assay or separate regional/TF contexts. No source was dropped because of model coverage.

issues_and_required_interpretive_caveats.finding: The frozen V1 literature caveat says promoter contact strengthens rs1795739 target assignment. Castaldi primary Results instead report contact for the segment containing rs2013701/rs7671167, in contrast to rs1795739.
issues_and_required_interpretive_caveats.disposition: Current V2 context correctly records rs1795739 regional contact as null. Preserve the frozen V1 file and explicitly document the V2 source-annotation correction; do not turn the positive reporter into a nucleotide null.

issues_and_required_interpretive_caveats.finding: S7 caption says its rows have combined P<.01, but GSTCD=.08222 and RUVBL1=.09719 exceed that rule. The abstract's RUVBL1 claim also conflicts with the S7 16HBE combined test.
issues_and_required_interpretive_caveats.disposition: Curation preserves numerical-rule nulls and the source conflict in notes; describe the disagreement explicitly rather than changing the threshold. These are regional contexts, not exact nucleotide labels.

issues_and_required_interpretive_caveats.finding: Authors label NHBE experiments CRISPRi, while their delivery method describes HiFi Cas9 nuclease RNP, not a dCas9 repressor.
issues_and_required_interpretive_caveats.disposition: Keep the reported class with the explicit mechanistic inconsistency. No natural-allele validation is inferred.

issues_and_required_interpretive_caveats.finding: Gong has recoverable explicit nulls but unresolved missing/QC states; Castaldi has complete design/count identities but incomplete published statistical labels; the other sources are selected heterogeneous cases.
issues_and_required_interpretive_caveats.disposition: Omit full-panel sensitivity/specificity, AUROC/AP and false-positive-rate claims. Preserve panel coverage and selected-case descriptive results with every unavailable/unevaluable state exposed.

limitations: This is a source-label review, not an independent genomic harmonization audit or model-comparison validation.
Publisher-inaccessible details are not reconstructed by assumptions; source limitations remain explicit.
